messages:
elaine: quick q — for per-tenant debug we want stable sampling keys so we can group traces without storing raw prompts. thoughts on 'deterministic fingerprint' vs ephemeral session id?

samir: I vote deterministic fingerprinting (hash of user_id + route) so samples are sticky across retries but not reversible. avoids storing raw text.

maya: careful: 'user_id' can be PII in some customers. need consent/opt-in and a policy for allowed keys. Also hashing alone can be brute-forced for small id spaces.

nick: agree with maya. we can HMAC with a tenant-scoped secret to prevent rainbow attacks. store only the HMAC output + salt meta (no raw id).

elaine: example HMAC approach I sketched:
```
# pseudo-config
sampling_key = HMAC_SHA256(tenant_secret, tenant_id || route)
selected = sampling_hash(sampling_key) < per_route_rate
```
This keeps tenant secret in KMS and never logs tenant_id.

samir: looks good. two followups: 1) how long do we keep the sampling_key in logs/audit? 2) how does this interact with inspect/breakglass when SRE needs to replay?

maya: 1) logs should only keep a truncated prefix (e.g., first 8 hex chars) and a purpose tag. 2) for breakglass we can surface a one-time inspect token that decrypts the mapping in a controlled audit flow (expiring, gated by 2FA + approval).

ops-oncall: +1 on one-time tokens. oncall needs a way to temporarily lift sampling redaction during incidents. but we must record who requested, justify reason, and auto-revoke. audit trail required.

nick: small implementation note: for per-tenant rate variance we can store per-route rate in config and compute deterministic_hash % 10000 < rate*100. deterministic_hash uses HKDF(sampling_key).

elaine: UX question for Console: should per-tenant sampling toggle be visible to customer admins or hidden behind support? Product implications.

maya: product: expose basic slider for sampling % with a note about PII implications and default OFF for new tenants. advanced mode requires legal review.

samir: telemetry/metrics: we should emit counts of sampled/un-sampled per-tenant but never include the tenant_id in raw metrics. emit hashed_tenant_bucket instead (k-anonymity).

nick: also surface a drift alert: if sampled fraction deviates from configured > 10% over 1h, send console alert and create a ticket. this catches secret rotation or bug regressions.

elaine: ok action items: 1) eng-platform to draft HMAC + truncated-log spec (samir + nick) 2) ops to propose breakglass flow + approval audit (ops-oncall + maya) 3) product to design console slider + default + notice (maya)

samir: I'll open the RFC and include sample code + threat model. ETA EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: deployment started: config/sampling/feature-flagging v2 -> staging (sha: f5d8a2) :rocket:

ops-oncall: quick note — when rolling to staging, add a canary tenant with explicit consent to validate inspect flow.

elaine: perfect. thanks folks :thumbsup:
